title: Incredible Hidden Valley Guided Hike in Phoenix, Arizona
blurb:
Experience even more of the fantastic Sonoran Desert and have extra fun with a sustained guided hike of three to four hours. We’ll customize the adventure to your mileage, terrain and grade preferences. Explore the amazing Sonoran Desert in Phoenix, Arizona, fun, experienced, local Mad Desert Trekking guide. 

We love the Sonoran Desert ... and we know you will, too.

Why should you book your Camelback Mountain hike with Mad Desert Trekking?

We approach every trip with fun in mind. Plus, our pro guides will show you the secrets of the area that few people know about. 

We will provide everything you need for your hiking adventure, including:
- Use of backpacks

Our number one priority is your safety. We guarantee a safe, enjoyable and memorable Sonoran Desert experience. The minimum age for this experience is 12. Let's Camelback Mountain!
